channel.desc: Join Hosts Pastor John and Angela Lomacang with guest Pastor Kevin Morgan he shares his journey of pastoral ministry, academic research, and a lifelong passion for the writings of Ellen G. White. From providential experiences that shaped his books to the launch of his YouTube channel Ellen White Reconsidered, Pastor Morgan offers unique insights into her life and message. Discover how his work is strengthening faith for both long-time Adventists and new believers alike.
